vintage: CORINE Land Cover 2018 / Agreste agricultural census 2020, ANCT communal geography 2026

lenses.name: Vineyards
lenses.description: Share of land classified as vineyards by CORINE Land Cover 2018, sampled on a 1 km lattice inside each hex.

lenses.name: Orchards & olives
lenses.description: Share of land classified as fruit-tree or olive plantations by CORINE Land Cover 2018.

lenses.name: Farm density
lenses.description: Agreste 2020 farm count per 100 km², aggregated from communes to hexes. Blank commune cells mean no farm or statistical suppression; those communes are omitted from both numerator and denominator rather than zero-filled.

lenses.name: Average farm size
lenses.description: Utilised agricultural area per farm in the 2020 agricultural census. Areas are assigned to the headquarters commune and may include land worked in other communes, so this is farm structure rather than a physical parcel map.
